name: Moving Average Crossover
thesis: Classic trend following: a fast average crossing a slow one marks the point at which recent order flow has decisively outweighed the prior consensus price, and momentum tends to continue past that pivot.
invalidation: Demote after profit factor below 0.85 over 20 trades or 6 consecutive losses.

provenance.note: Port of eval_ma_cross. The legacy version accepts a cross up to 2 bars old; this fires only on the cross bar itself.
